entry.title: Ghent: Frituur De Gouden Saté (Julien) has closed — kept for the record
entry.summary: Status source: Owners Caroline & Peter Taghon stopped frying for good on Sun 29 Sept 2025 after 44 years; original Overpoort frituur no longer operating (made-in.be, tagmag.news, nl.wikipedia). Founder Julien Taghon d. 2013

entry.title: Ghent: Souvenir has closed — kept for the record
entry.summary: Status source: Owners announced closure after 11 years in 2025, building sold; Brabantdam location no longer operating (souvenir.gent, press). Ran a temporary 2025 summer pop-up in Gentbrugge only
